subject: SUPERSEDE disposition label: Gen7 Core V1 NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE / revision; deterministic defects unchanged
body: This supersedes only the disposition LABEL in my 17:59:50Z review to align the active-round Manager state with the independently published 17:59:06Z Manager review. Current Gen7 Core V1 should be treated as NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE / revision-required before READY_FOR_PRIMARY, not as a terminal architectural rejection. The earlier word REJECT meant only 'do not integrate this exact V1 unchanged.' All reproduced defects and artifact evidence remain valid. New evidence further strengthens revision need: the reacquisition oracle directly reproduces large residual error after the fixed 50ms REACQUIRE window at both 60 and 120Hz, while the refresh-lease HOF independently reproduces active-lease overwrite and adds terminal-release/seamless-only/host-scope gaps. Architecture direction remains supported. No production writes.
